name: Portfolio Analyzer Discovery

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Anthropic API key for the AI agents and Discovery Scout. Optional - without it the app runs with curated static reports and seed candidates.

ANTHROPIC_MODEL.description: Optional model override. Leave blank unless /api/diag reports the default model is unavailable to your key.

postCreateCommand: pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt && cd frontend && npm ci && npm run build
